name: ES Overnight-to-Cash Anchor Relay v1
instrument: ES continuous front-month signal with one MES execution unit
research_motivation: The best saved candidates involve accepted inventory surviving a genuine participant handoff, while copying the same shape across arbitrary equal-length intraday blocks failed. This rule tests the actual Globex-to-cash handoff with no fitted magnitude or regime threshold.

eligibility.rth_session: 09:30 through 15:59 ET with at least 390 one-minute bars
eligibility.overnight_window: 18:00 ET on the prior calendar evening through 09:29 ET on the RTH date
eligibility.overnight_requirement: at least one bar and positive aggregate reported volume in the overnight window

rules.overnight_anchor: volume-weighted mean of one-minute typical price in the overnight window
rules.opening_center: volume-weighted mean of one-minute typical price in the opening auction
rules.long_signal: opening center > overnight anchor and 09:59 close > overnight anchor
rules.short_signal: opening center < overnight anchor and 09:59 close < overnight anchor
rules.entry: 10:00 open plus one adverse ES tick
rules.stop_fill: opening auction center plus one adverse ES tick
rules.entry_validity: skip if the frozen stop fill is not adverse to the simulated entry
rules.same_bar_rule: if the 10:00 entry bar touches the stop trigger, assume the stop fills
rules.gap_through_rule: if a stop bar opens beyond the trigger, fill at the worse bar open plus one adverse tick; otherwise fill at the frozen stop price
rules.survivor_exit: 15:30 open plus one adverse ES tick
rules.position_limit: one MES and at most one trade per RTH session

economics.slippage_model: one adverse tick at entry and one adverse tick at exit or stop

lesson: A Globex volume-weighted center is not a stable anchor for the later cash session. The development edge decayed to flat in 2024 and negative in 2025, with the short side failing. The rule must not be rescued with a post-hoc long-only filter or altered overnight window. The stronger saved mechanisms rely on anchors formed or defended by cash-session participants themselves.
holdout_policy: The one-shot secondary 2024-2025 evaluation is complete. No parameter, side, clock, or regime variation may be tested on those years for this family.
prohibited_posthoc_changes: changing the overnight or opening windows
changing the stop or exit after observing results
